fields.instruction_en: Enter your full name as on Aadhaar. KCC provides flexible credit for agricultural needs at subsidized interest rate of 7% p.a. (effective 4% with interest subvention).
fields.instruction_hi: Aadhaar ke anusar poora naam likhein. KCC 7% saalaana rin par krishi zaruraton ke liye flexible credit deta hai (interest subvention ke saath effective 4%).

fields.instruction_en: Enter your cultivated land area in hectares. KCC credit limit is based on scale of finance for the crop, land area, and post-harvest expenses.
fields.instruction_hi: Apna jot bhoomi kshetrafal hectare mein likhein. KCC ki credit limit fasal ke liye scale of finance, bhoomi kshetrafal aur post-harvest kharche par aadharit hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter the crops you cultivate (e.g., wheat, rice, cotton). KCC covers crop cultivation, post-harvest expenses, produce marketing, consumption requirements, and allied activities.
fields.instruction_hi: Aap jo fasalyaan ugaate hain unka naam likhein (jaise gehu, chawal, kapas). KCC fasal upaaj, post-harvest kharche, upaj marketing, upabhog zaruraton aur allied activities ko cover karta hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your existing bank account number. KCC is issued as a revolving credit facility linked to your savings account for easy withdrawal and repayment.
fields.instruction_hi: Apna maujuda bank khata number likhein. KCC aapke savings account se linked revolving credit facility ke roop mein jaari kiya jaata hai asaan nikaasi aur bhugtaan ke liye.

fields.instruction_en: Enter 12-digit Aadhaar. KCC is now linked with PM-KISAN — PM-KISAN beneficiaries can get KCC with simplified procedures.
fields.instruction_hi: 12 ank ka Aadhaar likhein. KCC ab PM-KISAN se linked hai — PM-KISAN labhaarthi simplified prakriyaon se KCC pa sakte hain.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your 10-digit mobile number for KCC account alerts, repayment reminders and SMS banking.
fields.instruction_hi: KCC account alerts, bhugtaan reminders aur SMS banking ke liye apna 10 ank ka mobile number likhein.
